plugins.name: android-tools
plugins.description: Android CLI tools: adb, emulator control, and device management

plugins.name: invoke-agent
plugins.description: Invoke external AI agents (Claude, Cursor Agent, Gemini) from Claude Code

plugins.name: worktree-tools
plugins.description: Open the current git worktree in a target environment: a cmux split pane, a new cmux workspace, or VS Code

plugins.name: cmux-tools
plugins.description: cmux workspace helpers: open a new workspace running a named, remote-controlled Claude Code session, and inject slash commands into already-running panes (one session or broadcast to all)

plugins.name: markdown-tools
plugins.description: View or open Markdown files: surface full content over remote control, or open locally in the macOS default app

plugins.name: pr-tools
plugins.description: GitHub pull request helpers: rewrite a PR title and body into the repository's own skeleton (PR template or merged-PR pattern, Why/What/How when it has none) carrying only what the diff cannot show, maintain a stacked-PR series section across a chain of PRs, and open a PR in Google Chrome

plugins.name: session-tools
plugins.description: Session-lifecycle helpers: a self-check reminder that re-injects an independent-verification directive after compaction and periodically in long sessions, plus a write-handoff-prompt skill for authoring goal-first continuation prompts that hand over the goal rather than the method

plugins.name: review-tools
plugins.description: Review helpers: cross-doc-review and cross-code-review review an artifact with two independent reviewer agents which check each other and adjudicate any single-reviewer finding before it is adopted; comments-cleanup strips comments that tell the reader nothing beyond what the code itself says out of a code change and rewrites the survivors to state what the code does
